CES.candidate_party: Literal corresponding HouseCandNParty_post_22/_24; never infer party from numeric choice position.
CES.nonvote_responses: Keep contest nonvote, 2022 reported election nonvote, unknown and administrative nonvote distinct.
CES.private_scopes: 51 matched-record state codes, UNLOCATED and ALL_SOURCE. Record-state differences are not proven election-day migration.
CES.private_queries: All administrative P/N/U by reported D/R/O/contest-nonvote/reported-election-nonvote/unknown at each wave; all raw cases and each positive-weight frame accounted.
CES.public_eligible_scope: ALL_SOURCE only, including DC/unlocated source cases where eligible; not a national population estimate.
CES.public_eligible_selection: Both administrative histories positive, both reported House choices known D/R, positive commonpostweight_24.
CES.public_all_other_queries: whole-table hold without numeric cells or statistics
CES.frame_limitations: Recruited among 2020 adults, retained through 2024; excludes newly first-age-eligible 2022/2024 entrants; not representative of the full 2024 or 2026 population by assumption.

AP2024.selected_frame: Pooled positive poll-close state-weight source cases classified LIKELYVOTER=1 with known recalled House22 and current House24 D/R responses.
AP2024.recalled_2022: Use actual QVOTE2022 with 1=R/2=D; QPVVOTE22 codes1..3 override as reported nonvote; never consume QVOTE2022S.
AP2024.current_2024: HOUSEVOTE1=D/2=R among modeled current voters; source response is not candidate-specific administrative truth.

statistics.switching: 100*(w_DR+w_RD)/(w_DD+w_DR+w_RD+w_RR), conditional on each source-specific selected known-major-choice frame.
statistics.directional: Previous D or R row conditional rates among selected current D/R choices; not all previous coalition members.
statistics.comparison: AP source point rate minus retained CES point rate in percentage points; unmatched source concordance only.

delivery: Complete permitted coarse sufficient inputs, every public query/hold/result, exact code/tests, private independent arithmetic verification and standard-library-only offline public replay; preserve original private sources and immutable predecessors.
